reviews.text: I had this app once before and didn’t get on much so I deleted it. I saw it while playing a game and thought I would check out the reviews to see if there was anything new. I was surprised by how many people are complaining about having to pay and how many people are using a game instead of a doctor to diagnose whether they are adhd or not. I thoroughly enjoyed this app when I had it a few months ago and downloading again now.

reviews.title: What a lovely scam
reviews.text: I really wanted this app because I found out it had and adhd test so I bought the app and I took the test and I literally had to pay just to see my results! I really hate this and for a year I’ve been trying to find out if I had ADHD and even autism and this is how I get paid. It’s just SO thoughtful of you guys to scam us. You know I love this scam it’s SO funny and hilarious how some people might have childhood trauma and take this test and literally have to pay for it I really hope that this helps you through life. You guys are just BEGGING for money aren’t you?

reviews.title: Shame on you!
reviews.text:
I normally don’t write reviews, but I just had to say  your ad caught  my eye about childhood trauma. I am a woman that still even past 50 am struggles with childhood trauma. Thought huh could there be a way to train my brain to not think or directly go there?  The only thing I see in this app is a bunch of money hungry developers that said let’s pray on some weak people and take them for every 7.99 a week we can. Tell them that it might be adhd or they need sleep training…no they need this another $7.99. You hear cha Ching Well I’m not laughing! This should have fell under one umbrella (at this point I’m not sure it is worth the $32 or 34 a year). As I started this with shame on you if you even care enough to read the reviews in the first place. 
Thank you all for your time, I’ll step down now.

reviews.title: Started with interesting ad
reviews.text:
I’ve seen a few of these that make you fill out a lot of info about your goals before finding out its only subscription.  I overcame that negative based on the ad and tried the 3 day trial.  It started me off with arithmetic game (like 2+2=4) so I canceled out of that. I bounced around to a couple tests that were standard rate this from 1-5, and not what I saw on the ads.  

I canceled out of those and tried the IQ test.  Interesting but only pattern recognition and frankly repetitive.  After 30 questions (and could take 30 minutes to complete) I find out that the results are only available for $8 a week subscription, not trial version. 
Tell me in advance if it’s not included. 

I immediately canceled my trial version and deleted the app.  Thanks for wasting my time with your shiesty and deceptive app.
